doc.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

title: Rowe's introduction; forward-thinking careers
summary: Rowe introduces Ali and Grimes at Hamilton College and asks if they think of themselves as forward thinking.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming at Hamilton College for the Jazz Archive, and I’m really pleased to have Henry Grimes and Rashied Ali with me today, two of the most forward thinking people I’ve come to know, I think it’s safe to say. Do you think of yourself as a forward thinking person?

I like to see a career where, you know if you look in the bios about you guys it will say that you played with this fellow and that fellow and this band, and now it’s come to the point where if you look up people and lists that they’ve played with you.
Well yeah, I guess, you know, we’ve been around the block a few times. So it’s a lot of that going on there.
